name: Budget Allocation Variant 3
task:
Please complete the following four-stage budget task.

A hospital: $20,000,000. Emergency (30%), Surgery (25%), Pediatrics (20%), Admin (15%), Research (10%). Surgery needs $500,000 for new equipment. Minimum 10% per department.

Calculate NPV for each proposed project.

Reallocate within budget caps.

Compare allocation strategies.
